# Accessibility Statement

ZeroLabz is committed to ensuring our post-quantum cryptography tools and development environments are accessible to all engineers.

## Supported Environments
- The `zerolabz-lattice-coder` VS Code extension strictly adheres to VS Code's native accessibility guidelines, supporting screen readers, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast themes.
- Command-line interfaces and npm outputs are optimized for text-to-speech readability.

## Reporting Issues
If you encounter any accessibility barriers within our tools, please report them to **dev@zrolabz.com**.
